Name: FishingTweaks
Author: TWT233
Description:
[b][size=4]TL;DR & Usage[/size][/b]
Just hold your rod, and press (V) to toggle all functions!

[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
Fishing in Stardew Valley is relaxing, but sometimes it's so time-wasting too
This mod automating repetitive tasks: auto-casting, auto-baiting, treasure collection, etc.
and the ability to skip the fishing minigame [color=#00ff00][b]after you've caught a type of fish enough times[/b](configurable)[/color]

[b][size=4]Features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Auto-Casting: Automatically casts your fishing rod (auto disabled and pause game in low stamina)
[*]Auto-Baiting: Automatically applies bait from your inventory when depleted
[*]Auto-Tackling: Automatically replaces broken tackle from your inventory
[*]Auto-Hook: Automatically apply auto hook enchantment for the rod
[*]Auto-Treasure Collection: Automatically collects items from fishing treasure chests
[*]Skip Fish Animation: Skips the animation shown after catching a fish
[*]Skip Fishing Minigame: Automatically completes the fishing minigame for fish you've caught multiple times
[*]Fishing Statistics: Tracks how many times you've caught each fish
[/list]
[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
Every feature noted is configurable
The mod can be configured by using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] if installed or through the config.json file

[size=4][b]太长不看[/b][/size]
装备鱼竿、按一下V键就可以开关所有功能！

[b][size=4]描述[/size][/b]
在星露谷钓鱼一般都蛮让人放松的，但是有时候确实会比较枯燥
本mod提供了自动抛竿、自动补充鱼饵、宝箱收集等功能
还能在你[color=#00ff00][b]多次捕获特定鱼类后[/b](次数可自定义)[/color]自动跳过这种鱼的钓鱼小游戏

[b][size=4]功能[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]自动抛竿：自动投掷钓鱼竿(体力不足时自动停止+暂停游戏)
[*]自动补充鱼饵：当鱼饵耗尽时自动从背包中补充
[*]自动补充钓具：当钓具损坏时自动从背包中替换
[*]自动上钩：自动为钓竿附魔自动上钩
[*]自动收集宝箱：自动收集钓鱼宝箱中的物品
[*]跳过展示鱼环节：跳过钓到鱼后的展示动画
[*]跳过钓鱼小游戏：对于已多次捕获的鱼类自动完成钓鱼小游戏
[*]钓鱼统计：记录每种鱼的捕获次数
[/list]
[b][size=4]修改配置[/size][/b]
安装[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]后在游戏内即可进行配置，也可以手动修改config.json配置文件
